enrichment.headline: Moves $16,000 at Skyline High from three budget lines to teacher stipends (Measure N)
enrichment.summary: On the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the Board approves a 2022-23 budget change for Skyline High School. It moves $16,000 into Teacher Salaries Stipends from three lines: Conference Expenses ($12,000), Transportation Costs ($3,000) and Teacher Salaries ($1,000). This is a shift within the school's existing budget rather than new spending.

enrichment.headline: Awards G & G Builders $116,977 for playground and multi-sport court work at Howard Elementary
schools: Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School
enrichment.summary: G & G Builders, Inc., of Livermore, was the lowest responsive bidder for site improvements at the Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School. The work includes removing basketball hoops, preparing the site for a KABOOM multi-sport court, and installing new playground tiles on the existing asphalt. The $116,977 price includes a $10,000 contingency allowance, and work is expected to start September 29, 2022 and last 60 days.

schools: Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School
enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants, of Oakland, will sample and test soil for lead and arsenic, characterize soil waste, review data and write reports for the Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School site improvements project. The cap of $7,760.50 includes up to $705.50 for additional services. Work is scheduled from September 29 to December 29, 2022.
